evidenceNeeded: Manual Sunbiz Fictitious Name / Corporation search for HELLOFRESH / HELLO FRESH in Miami-Dade.
Ask the merchant for proof of authorisation to use the HelloFresh name, domain and descriptor (franchise/reseller agreement), or require a descriptor and website change.
Ask what is actually sold and where (premises address, photos, food-establishment permit).
Representative identity and Stripe KYC status; confirm no link to Grocery Delivery E-Services USA, Inc.
summary: A Florida sole proprietor in Olympia Heights declares hellofresh.com as its website and HELLOFRESH.COM as its descriptor; the site's Terms of Use show it is operated by Grocery Delivery E-Services USA, Inc., an unrelated Delaware corporation. There is no local food store called Hellofresh and the contact is a personal aol.com email, so this looks like brand impersonation / descriptor misuse with high chargeback and confusion risk. Total 27 risk points (operating 10, contact 10, businessModel 7). Hold payouts pending proof of authorisation and of the actual business; require descriptor/website correction.
